name: Down For Everyone Or Just Me

mentions.name: Down For Everyone Or Just Me
mentions.description: A web service status checker that tells you whether a website is down or whether it is just you, including reported reasons from the community. Work is underway to add user accounts so users can create custom lists of websites and services to track.
mentions.problem: It can be hard to tell whether a website is down for everyone or just for you.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is a fun one I do with a good friend. Basically, to see if a website is down, or if it is just you, along with reported reasons from the community. We are working to add user accounts so you can create your own custom lists of websites/services to track
